name: GLnexus
use_en: Joint-genotypes DeepVariant gVCFs into a cohort VCF.
use_zh: 把 DeepVariant gVCF 联合分型成队列 VCF。
note: AM03 alternative to GATK GenotypeGVCFs.

name: BWA (bwa mem / bwa aln)
use_en: bwa mem for modern reads; bwa aln is the aDNA default (see grapevine-adna).
use_zh: 现代数据用 bwa mem；古DNA默认用 bwa aln（见 grapevine-adna）。

name: bwa-mem2
use_en: Default short-read mapper for modern grape resequencing (AM03).
use_zh: 现代葡萄重测序的默认短读比对器（AM03）。
note: Use bwa aln for degraded aDNA; that route is in grapevine-adna.

name: samtools
use_en: Sort, index, mark duplicates, filter and report alignment statistics.
use_zh: 排序、建索引、标记重复、过滤并汇报比对统计。
note: Same 1.25 line as bcftools and htslib. samtools is not a mapper; it belongs with BAM processing, not under Mapping.

cluster: Phasing and imputation of modern data (in order)
name: Beagle
use_en: Phasing and imputation alternative to SHAPEIT5 and GLIMPSE2.
use_zh: 相对于 SHAPEIT5 和 GLIMPSE2 的定相与补全备选。
note: Bioconda build date is 22 July 2022. Check the author site before pinning a newer unlisted build [待确认]. Beagle 5 paper DOI (Browning et al. 2018) verified by Crossref in the literature review.

cluster: Phasing and imputation of modern data (in order)
name: GLIMPSE2
ver_src: GitHub odelaneau/GLIMPSE tag v2.0.0 (latest stable), 2026-11-14 CST; v2.0.1 is a GitHub pre-release and is not used as the catalogue version
use_en: Imputes low-coverage genomes from a haplotype reference panel.
use_zh: 用单倍型参考面板补全低覆盖度基因组。
inp: low-coverage BAM or genotype likelihoods, reference panel
note: For aDNA, test accuracy on modern grapes downsampled to ancient depths first (AM17, project 20). GitHub v2.0.1 is marked pre-release (checked 2026-11-14 CST); Bioconda glimpse-bio may still list 2.0.1. This catalogue pins the latest stable tag, 2.0.0, consistent with not using RC or beta tags as the catalogue version.

cluster: Phasing and imputation of modern data (in order)
name: SHAPEIT5
use_en: Phases common then rare variants. Default in AM13 and AM26, with a published linkage map when one exists.
use_zh: 先对常见变异再对稀有变异定相。AM13 和 AM26 的默认工具，有已发表连锁图时使用该图。
note: Do not use a pyrho map for phasing (AM26).

cluster: Phasing and imputation of modern data (in order)
name: WhatsHap
use_en: Read-backed phasing, useful where long reads or linked reads exist.
use_zh: 基于读段的定相，有长读或连锁读段时有用。

name: FastQC
use_en: Per-file read quality, length and adapter content.
use_zh: 逐文件的读段质量、长度和接头含量。

name: MultiQC
use_en: Aggregates QC reports from many tools into one HTML summary.
use_zh: 把多种工具的质控报告汇总成一份 HTML。

name: fastp
use_en: Trims adapters and low-quality bases and writes a QC report.
use_zh: 修剪接头和低质量碱基，并写出质控报告。
note: GitHub release 2026-10-07. Also in vitis-open-directions AM02.

name: seqkit
use_en: FASTQ/FASTA statistics, filtering and conversion.
use_zh: FASTQ/FASTA 统计、过滤和格式转换。

name: KING
use_en: Robust kinship for clones or duplicates versus first-degree relatives. Clones and duplicates (kinship above 0.354) are reduced to one sample per group; first-degree relatives (0.177-0.354) are registered, not dropped as the same genotype.
use_zh: 用于区分克隆/重复与一级亲缘的稳健亲缘估计。克隆和重复（亲缘系数高于 0.354）每组只留一个样本；一级亲缘（0.177-0.354）只登记，不当作同一基因型删掉。
note: Thresholds follow the KING manual (https://www.kingrelatedness.com/manual.shtml): kinship above 0.354 is the duplicate/MZ class; 0.177-0.354 is first-degree. Paper: Manichaikul et al. 2010, 10.1093/bioinformatics/btq559. AM26 used 0.177 as the first-degree lower cutoff. Input should be hard-called diploid genotypes (BED). For low-coverage or ancient samples use ngsRelate, READv2, KIN or BREADR instead. Handling of first-degree relatives is analysis-specific; see docs/WORKFLOW.md.

name: PLINK 1.9
use_en: Older PLINK still needed for some ROH runs and file conversions.
use_zh: 旧版 PLINK，部分 ROH 和格式转换仍会用到。
note: DOI is Purcell et al. 2007. Chang et al. 2015 (doi:10.1186/s13742-015-0047-8) describes 1.9.

name: peddy
use_en: Relatedness and ancestry-outlier QC. Mammal-style sex checks do not transfer to Vitis.
use_zh: 亲缘和祖源离群点质控。哺乳动物式的性别检查不能照搬到葡萄。

name: plink2
use_en: Converts VCF to analysis files and runs PCA, relatedness and basic association.
use_zh: 把 VCF 转成分析文件，并做 PCA、亲缘和基础关联。
note: Newest GitHub tag uses pre-release-style numbering. Bioconda still 2.00a5.10. The DOI is Chang et al. 2015 (PLINK 1.9); a separate paper for this exact 2.0 tag was not confirmed.

name: somalier
use_en: Fast relatedness and sample-swap checks from BAM or VCF.
use_zh: 从 BAM 或 VCF 快速检查亲缘和样本是否拿错。
note: Like peddy and verifybamid2, this tool ships with human site lists. Build a grape site set before using it on Vitis; off-the-shelf human sites are not appropriate.

name: verifybamid2
use_en: Estimates BAM-versus-VCF contamination and swaps. Written for humans; treat grape values as exploratory.
use_zh: 估计 BAM 与 VCF 之间的污染和样本对调。原为人类设计，葡萄上的数值只作探索。
note: See grapevine-adna for plant contamination.

name: Picard
use_en: MarkDuplicates, read groups, CleanSam and related BAM hygiene.
use_zh: MarkDuplicates、读组、CleanSam 等 BAM 整理。
note: Picard works on BAM (MarkDuplicates, read groups, CleanSam), not on VCF. GitHub release 2026-07-31 CST-relative: 2026-08-01 02:56 CST.

name: bcftools
use_en: Filter, normalise, annotate, compute statistics, and call ROH (see section 8).
use_zh: 过滤、规范化、注释、统计，以及 ROH 检测（见第 8 节）。

name: htslib
use_en: Library behind samtools and bcftools; pin it to the same 1.25 line.
use_zh: samtools 和 bcftools 的底层库，应与 1.25 同一条线钉死。

name: mosdepth
use_en: Fast per-base and window depth, used to build callable-site masks.
use_zh: 快速计算逐碱基和窗口深度，用来做可检测位点掩膜。
note: Newest is GitHub 0.3.15; Bioconda lagged at 0.3.14 on 2026-11-14.

name: vcftools
use_en: Classic VCF filtering and window statistics. Prefer pixy for pi and dxy on all-sites VCFs.
use_zh: 经典 VCF 过滤和窗口统计。全位点 VCF 上的 pi 和 dxy 更建议用 pixy。
note: No newer tagged release than 0.1.17.

name: vt
use_en: Normalises and decomposes complex variants before cohort QC.
use_zh: 在队列质控前规范化并拆分复杂变异。

name: DeepVariant
use_en: Default modern SNP/indel caller in the AM03 sketch (WGS model).
use_zh: AM03 草图中现代 SNP/indel 的默认检测器（WGS 模型）。
note: Joint-genotype gVCFs with GLnexus. Record whether a plant-trained model is used.

name: GATK HaplotypeCaller / GenotypeGVCFs
use_en: Alternative caller and joint-genotyping route for short-read SNPs and indels.
use_zh: 短读 SNP 和 indel 的备选检测与联合分型路径。

name: Octopus
use_en: Haplotype caller with strong indel and regional-haplotype modelling.
use_zh: 对 indel 和局部单倍型建模较强的检测器。

name: freebayes
use_en: Haplotype-based Bayesian caller, useful in highly heterozygous grape regions.
use_zh: 基于单倍型的贝叶斯检测器，适用于葡萄高杂合区域。

cluster: Chromosome painting and local ancestry (in order)
name: Loter
use_en: Phasing-free local ancestry for two or more sources.
use_zh: 无需预先定相的二源或多源局部祖源。

cluster: Chromosome painting and local ancestry (in order)
name: RFMix
ver_src: Bioconda rfmix, 2026-11-14 CST (same string as AM13)
use_en: Local ancestry after SHAPEIT5 phasing; default in AM13.
use_zh: SHAPEIT5 定相后的局部祖源，AM13 默认工具。

cluster: Chromosome painting and local ancestry (in order)
name: fineSTRUCTURE / ChromoPainter
ver_src: Vendor site; version not checked in this build
use_en: Paints chromosomes as mosaics of donor haplotypes, finer than a single ADMIXTURE K.
use_zh: 把染色体画成供体单倍型马赛克，比单一 ADMIXTURE K 更细。
note: Version [待确认].

name: ADMIXTURE
use_en: Maximum-likelihood ancestry proportions; default in AM13.
use_zh: 最大似然祖源比例，AM13 的默认工具。
note: Clone-prune first (one sample per clone or duplicate group). First-degree relatives should not be dropped as if they were the same genotype; for ADMIXTURE use an unrelated subset or report a sensitivity analysis (see docs/WORKFLOW.md). Choose K with cross-validation and inspect fit with evalAdmix.

name: fastSTRUCTURE
use_en: Variational STRUCTURE-like model for large SNP sets.
use_zh: 面向大型 SNP 集的变分 STRUCTURE 类模型。
note: Last tagged release remains 1.0.

name: sNMF (LEA)
use_en: Fast sparse NMF ancestry, often more tolerant of missing data than ADMIXTURE.
use_zh: 快速稀疏 NMF 祖源，对缺失数据往往比 ADMIXTURE 更宽容。

name: ANGSD
use_en: Genotype likelihoods, allele frequencies, SFS, association and haploid calls from BAM.
use_zh: 从 BAM 计算基因型似然、等位基因频率、SFS、关联和单倍型调用。
out: genotype likelihoods, SFS, MAF, haploid calls
note: Central for aDNA and low-coverage modern data. Human X-chromosome contamination utilities do not transfer to grape.

name: PCAngsd
use_en: PCA and admixture-style structure from genotype likelihoods, including low coverage.
use_zh: 用基因型似然做 PCA 和类混合结构分析，适用于低覆盖度。
note: Newest GitHub tag is 1.37.0; Bioconda lagged at 1.36.4.

name: evalAdmix
use_en: Checks whether an ADMIXTURE or NGSadmix Q matrix actually fits the data.
use_zh: 检查 ADMIXTURE 或 NGSadmix 的 Q 矩阵是否真的拟合数据。
inp: genotype likelihoods or genotypes, Q matrix
note: DOI (Garcia-Erill and Albrechtsen 2020) verified by Crossref in the 2026-11-14 literature review.

name: flashpca
use_en: Fast PCA on large SNP matrices.
use_zh: 大型 SNP 矩阵上的快速 PCA。

name: smartpca (EIGENSOFT)
ver_src: Bioconda eigensoft 9.0.0; DReichLab/EIG GitHub tag v8.0.0
use_en: PCA with shrinkage and lsqproject, the usual way to project aDNA onto a modern PCA.
use_zh: 带收缩和 lsqproject 的 PCA，通常用来把古DNA投射到现代 PCA 上。
note: Pin the exact binary. Bioconda and GitHub numbers disagree.

name: pophelper
use_en: Aligns and plots ADMIXTURE or STRUCTURE Q matrices across K.
use_zh: 对齐并绘制不同 K 下的 ADMIXTURE 或 STRUCTURE Q 矩阵。

name: lostruct
ver_src: GitHub petrelharp/local_pca; no release tag in this check
use_en: Windowed local PCA to find inversions and local ancestry tracts.
use_zh: 窗口局部 PCA，用来找倒位和局部祖源区段。
note: Useful on grape inversion candidates; see also vitis-pangenome and vitis-open-directions project 17.

name: FEEMS
use_en: Estimates effective migration surfaces from sample geography.
use_zh: 根据样本地理坐标估计有效迁移表面。
note: This repository does not accept private site coordinates.

name: conStruct
use_en: Spatial structure that separates isolation by distance from admixture.
use_zh: 把距离隔离和混合分开的空间结构模型。

name: BEAST 2
use_en: Bayesian trees and tip-dating when time calibrations exist.
use_zh: 有时间校准时可做贝叶斯树和末端定年。
note: For aDNA tip-dating use transversions or UDG-treated data.

name: FastTree
use_en: Approximate ML tree for very large alignments, as a first look.
use_zh: 超大比对的近似最大似然树，适合先看一眼。

name: IQ-TREE 2
use_en: Previous major line of IQ-TREE, still widely used.
use_zh: IQ-TREE 的上一主线，仍广泛使用。
note: Listed because many published grape trees used v2; prefer v3 for new work unless a pipeline is pinned.

name: IQ-TREE 3
use_en: Default ML tree builder in AM23.
use_zh: AM23 中的默认最大似然建树工具。
note: Do not put the IQ-TREE 2 DOI (10.1093/molbev/msaa015) in this row's DOI field. That DOI belongs to IQ-TREE 2 and is recorded only here as a cross-reference. An IQ-TREE 3 paper DOI was not confirmed [待确认].

name: RAxML-NG
use_en: Alternative ML tree search, convenient on large SNP matrices.
use_zh: 备选最大似然搜索，适合较大 SNP 矩阵。

name: TreeMix
use_en: Graph of population splits plus migration edges.
use_zh: 群体分裂加迁移边的图模型。
note: Choose the number of migration edges with OptM and residual plots; clone-prune first.

name: OptM
use_en: Helps pick the number of TreeMix migration edges.
use_zh: 帮助选择 TreeMix 迁移边的数目。
note: DOI (Fitak 2021) verified by Crossref in the literature review.

name: Twisst
use_en: Topology weighting along the genome, useful for introgression windows.
use_zh: 沿基因组做拓扑加权，适合看渗入窗口。

name: ASTRAL
use_en: Species tree from unrooted gene trees under the multispecies coalescent.
use_zh: 在多物种溯祖下由无根基因树估计物种树。
note: More relevant to Vitaceae family phylogeny than to cultivar SNPs.

name: SplitsTree
ver_src: Official site; version not checked in this build
use_en: NeighborNet and other split networks for conflicting histories.
use_zh: NeighborNet 等分裂网络，用来表现相互冲突的历史。
note: Version [待确认].

name: ggtree
ver_src: Bioconductor; GitHub path not resolved in this check
use_en: Grammar-of-graphics plotting of trees and associated data.
use_zh: 用图形语法绘制树及相关数据。
note: Version [待确认].

cluster: ARG methods alternative to the tsinfer/tsdate pair (alternatives)
name: Relate
ver_src: No public tag resolved in this check (MyersGroup/relate returned 404)
use_en: Genome-wide genealogy estimation for thousands of samples; also feeds selection tests.
use_zh: 面向数千样本的全基因组谱系估计，也可供选择检验使用。
note: An alternative to the tsinfer-then-tsdate pair, not to tsinfer alone. Version and some setup details [待确认]. Sample time for a cultivar should be its sexual origin.

cluster: ARG methods alternative to the tsinfer/tsdate pair (alternatives)
name: SINGER
use_en: ARG inference with posterior sampling, an alternative to tsinfer plus tsdate.
use_zh: 带后验抽样的 ARG 推断，作为 tsinfer 加 tsdate 的备选。
note: An alternative to the tsinfer-then-tsdate pair. The listed version string includes beta and is used only because no later stable tag was confirmed in the v1 check [待确认] (whether a later stable tag exists). Sample time for a cultivar should be its sexual origin.

name: tsdate
use_en: Dates a tsinfer tree sequence.
use_zh: 为 tsinfer 得到的树序列定年。
note: Dates a tree sequence produced by tsinfer; it is the second step of that pair, not an alternative to tsinfer. Sample times should be sexual-origin dates for clonal cultivars.

name: tsinfer
use_en: Infers a tree sequence (ARG approximation) from phased large samples.
use_zh: 从已定相的大样本推断树序列（ARG 的近似）。
note: Run tsinfer first, then date the tree sequence with tsdate. Clone-prune and record close kinship first (AM14, project 10). For a cultivar, the sample time should be the sexual origin, not the extraction year.

name: tskit
use_en: Library for tree sequences produced by tsinfer, msprime or SLiM.
use_zh: 处理 tsinfer、msprime 或 SLiM 产生的树序列的库。

cluster: Recent Ne from LD or IBD (alternatives)
name: GONE2
ver_src: GitHub esrud/GONE2 release v2.0.2, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Recent effective size from the linkage-disequilibrium spectrum; successor of GONE.
use_zh: 用连锁不平衡谱推断近期有效种群大小，是 GONE 的后续版本。
note: Newest version of this lineage (GONE replaced by GONE2). The model assumes random mating and no strong structure; selfing, clones and population structure violate those assumptions, so clone-prune first and state the assumptions in the write-up. A related contemporary-Ne tool is currentNe.

name: GADMA
use_en: Automated search of demographic model structure on top of dadi or moments or fastsimcoal2.
use_zh: 在 dadi、moments 或 fastsimcoal2 之上自动搜索人口学模型结构。

name: dadi
use_en: Fits demographic models to the site-frequency spectrum.
use_zh: 用位点频率谱拟合人口学模型。

name: fastsimcoal2
ver_src: Author site; no Bioconda hit in this check
use_en: Composite-likelihood demographic inference under complex models, including site frequency spectra.
use_zh: 在复杂模型下用复合似然做人口学推断，包括位点频率谱。
note: Software version [待确认]; the 2021 Bioinformatics paper DOI was verified.

name: moments
use_en: SFS and LD-based demographic inference, including momentsLD.
use_zh: 基于 SFS 和 LD 的人口学推断，也包括 momentsLD。

name: demes / demesdraw
use_en: A common YAML format for demographic models, plus plotting.
use_zh: 人口学模型的通用 YAML 格式，并附带绘图。

name: MSMC2
use_en: Cross-coalescence and Ne from a few phased haplotypes.
use_zh: 从少量已定相单倍型估计交叉溯祖和有效种群大小。
note: The catalogue DOI is Schiffels and Durbin 2014 (MSMC). MSMC2 is the later implementation, described in Schiffels and Wang 2020, 10.1007/978-1-0716-0199-0_7. Hybrid-origin cultivars can produce false old Ne peaks because the two haplotypes come from different source populations. For a clonal cultivar the sample time should be the sexual-origin date, treated as a parameter or a sensitivity analysis when that date is unknown.

name: PSMC
ver: [待确认] (repo has unusual latest tag fixed-max-t)
ver_src: GitHub lh3/psmc; Bioconda psmc; tag is not a clean version number
use_en: Classic single-diploid Ne history; a useful baseline, but sensitive to heterozygosity and ROH in grape, and to hybrid origin.
use_zh: 经典的单个二倍体 Ne 历史，可作为基线，但对葡萄的杂合度、ROH 和杂交起源都敏感。
note: Version tag is messy; pin a commit and record it. Highly homozygous lines such as PN40024 are a poor sole input. Hybrid-origin cultivars (for example crosses between eastern and western groups, or with sylvestris introgression) can show a false old Ne peak because the two haplotypes come from different sources. Convert to years only with an explicit generation-time assumption. Clonal propagation does not add meiotic generations; the sample time should be the sexual origin. Tag on GitHub is not a clean version number [待确认].

name: SMC++
use_en: Effective-size history from many unphased genomes.
use_zh: 从许多未定相基因组推断有效种群大小历史。
note: Reduce clones and duplicates to one sample per group. For recent Ne, also remove or model first-degree relatives (see docs/WORKFLOW.md). Clone-prune first. Convert to years only with an explicit generation-time assumption. For a clonal cultivar, the sample time should be the sexual origin, not the extraction year. Hybrid-origin diploids can distort the trajectory.

name: pixy
use_en: Unbiased pi, dxy and Fst from all-sites VCFs, including invariant sites.
use_zh: 用包含不变位点的全位点 VCF 无偏估计 pi、dxy 和 Fst。
note: Newest GitHub is 2.2.5; conda-forge lagged at 2.2.4. AM11 still recorded 2.2.4.

name: scikit-allel
use_en: Python library for window diversity, Fst, Patterson f-statistics and plotting.
use_zh: 用于窗口多样性、Fst、Patterson f 统计和绘图的 Python 库。

name: BayPass
use_en: Bayesian XtX differentiation and genotype-environment association.
use_zh: 贝叶斯 XtX 分化和基因型-环境关联。
note: Current official URL should be re-checked if the Forge moves [待确认].

name: BayeScan
use_en: Older Fst-outlier Bayesian scan; keep only as a legacy comparison.
use_zh: 较早的 Fst 离群贝叶斯扫描，仅作为对照保留。
note: Prefer pcadapt, OutFLANK or BayPass for new work.

name: LFMM 2
ver_src: GitHub bcm-uga/lfmm tag 1.1; Caye et al. 2019 paper verified
use_en: Latent-factor mixed model for genotype-environment association.
use_zh: 用潜在因子混合模型做基因型-环境关联。
note: Also listed under section 9. Version source: GitHub bcm-uga/lfmm 1.1; also packaged in Bioconductor LEA.

name: OutFLANK
ver_src: GitHub whitlock/OutFLANK; no tag in this check
use_en: Fst outlier test with a trimmed-null among loci.
use_zh: 用位点之间修剪后的空分布做 Fst 离群检验。
note: Version [待确认].

name: pcadapt
use_en: PCA-based outlier scan for selection, robust to some population structure.
use_zh: 基于 PCA 的选择离群扫描，对部分群体结构较稳健。

name: hapFLK
ver_src: PyPI hapflk 2.1 (2024-05-16), 2026-11-14 CST; official source INRAE Forge
use_en: Haplotype Fst that accounts for population structure, useful for cultivar-group contrasts.
use_zh: 考虑群体结构的单倍型 Fst，适合品种组之间的对比。
note: The previous GitHub URL bioinfo-lessmieux/hapflk returned 404 (checked 2026-11-14). Version source is PyPI 2.1; the Forge page may require a login. Bioconda version [待确认]. DOI is Fariello et al. 2013.

name: rehh
use_en: R implementation of EHH-based scans and plots.
use_zh: 基于 EHH 的扫描和作图的 R 实现。

name: selscan
use_en: iHS, nSL, XP-EHH and related haplotype scans, including unphased scans in 2.0+.
use_zh: iHS、nSL、XP-EHH 及相关单倍型扫描，2.0 以后也包括未定相扫描。
note: DOI is Szpiech 2024 (selscan 2.0). Original 2014 paper is doi:10.1093/molbev/msu211. Newest tag is 3.1.0.

name: diploS/HIC
use_en: Classifier for hard, soft and linked sweeps from window features, trained on simulations.
use_zh: 用窗口特征区分硬扫、软扫和连锁区域，需用模拟来训练。
note: Train on grape-like demography and clonality; off-the-shelf human models are not appropriate.

name: RAiSD
ver_src: GitHub alachins/raisd exists (updated 2026-11-04) but no tag in this check
use_en: Composite sweep statistic from mu, mu-var and mu-SFS; listed in AM11.
use_zh: 由 mu、mu-var 和 mu-SFS 组成的复合选择扫描统计，已列入 AM11。
note: Version remains [待确认], as in AM11.

name: SweepFinder2
use_en: CLR sweep scan that can include a demographic background SFS.
use_zh: 可纳入人口学背景 SFS 的 CLR 选择扫描。
note: Official URL should be confirmed against the current lab page [待确认] (if the URL moves).

name: XP-CLR
use_en: Cross-population composite likelihood ratio for sweeps, e.g. wild versus cultivated after clone removal.
use_zh: 跨群体复合似然比扫描，例如去克隆后的野生与栽培对比。

name: TreeMix
use_en: Migration edges on a population tree; complementary to f-statistic graphs.
use_zh: 群体树上的迁移边，与 f 统计图互为补充。
note: Same binary as section 3; listed here for the introgression workflow.

name: HyDe
use_en: Site-pattern test for hybridisation in phylogenetic trios.
use_zh: 用位点模式检验系统发育三元组中的杂交。

name: ADMIXTOOLS (qpDstat, qp3Pop, qpAdm, qpGraph)
use_en: Original C implementation of Patterson f-statistics and admixture-graph tools.
use_zh: Patterson f 统计和混合图工具的原始 C 实现。
note: DOI is Patterson et al. 2012. Prefer ADMIXTOOLS 2 for new analyses unless a pipeline is pinned to the C binary.

name: ADMIXTOOLS 2
use_en: f2, f3, f4, qpAdm and qpGraph in R, with block jackknife.
use_zh: 在 R 中计算 f2、f3、f4、qpAdm 和 qpGraph，并做区组刀切。
note: Default alternative in AM13. Maier et al. 2023 eLife DOI verified.

name: Dsuite
ver_src: GitHub millanek/Dsuite; no tag or Bioconda package in this check (same as AM13)
use_en: Fast D, f4-ratio and f-branch statistics with block jackknife.
use_zh: 快速计算 D、f4 比值和 f-branch，并做区组刀切。
note: Version remains [待确认], as in AM13. The 2021 paper DOI was verified.

cluster: Polarisation (before DFE, load and ARG) (in order)
name: est-sfs
ver_src: AM26 (2026-11-14); not re-checked against a public tag in this session
use_en: Probabilistic ancestral-state estimation from multiple outgroups.
use_zh: 用多个外类群做祖先状态的概率估计。
note: Polarisation is a prerequisite for unfolded DFE, load and ARG work, not an LD tool. Use two or more outgroups, never Muscadinia alone (AM26).

name: LDBlockShow
use_en: LD heatmaps and haplotype blocks around candidate loci.
use_zh: 候选位点附近的 LD 热图和单倍型块。

name: PopLDdecay
use_en: LD decay curves by population, a standard first plot after clone removal.
use_zh: 按群体画 LD 衰减曲线，去克隆后的标准第一张图。

cluster: LD-based recombination maps (alternatives, ARG input only)
name: LDhelmet
use_en: Alternative LD-based map, slower, used only if pyrho is unsuitable.
use_zh: 备选的基于 LD 的图谱，速度较慢，仅在 pyrho 不合适时使用。
note: AM26 alternative to pyrho.

cluster: LD-based recombination maps (alternatives, ARG input only)
name: ReLERNN
use_en: Recurrent-network estimator of recombination from simulations; treat as experimental on grape.
use_zh: 用模拟训练的循环网络估计重组；在葡萄上视为试验性方法。
note: Train on grape-like demography; do not reuse a human model.

cluster: LD-based recombination maps (alternatives, ARG input only)
name: pyrho
use_en: LD-based recombination rates. In AM26 it is used only as ARG input, never for SHAPEIT5 phasing.
use_zh: 基于 LD 的重组率。AM26 中只把它当作 ARG 的输入，不用来给 SHAPEIT5 定相。
note: Run per population after clone and first-degree pruning. See AM26 for why clonality and admixture LD bias rho.

name: GCTA
use_en: GRM-based relatedness and GBLUP; also used in GWAS (section 9).
use_zh: 基于 GRM 的亲缘和 GBLUP，也可用于 GWAS（第 9 节）。

name: KING
use_en: Robust kinship for clones or duplicates versus first-degree relatives. Clones and duplicates (kinship above 0.354) are reduced to one sample per group; first-degree relatives (0.177-0.354) are registered, not dropped as the same genotype.
use_zh: 用于区分克隆/重复与一级亲缘的稳健亲缘估计。克隆和重复（亲缘系数高于 0.354）每组只留一个样本；一级亲缘（0.177-0.354）只登记，不当作同一基因型删掉。
note: Thresholds follow the KING manual (https://www.kingrelatedness.com/manual.shtml): kinship above 0.354 is the duplicate/MZ class; 0.177-0.354 is first-degree. Paper: Manichaikul et al. 2010, 10.1093/bioinformatics/btq559. AM26 used 0.177 as the first-degree lower cutoff. Input should be hard-called diploid genotypes (BED). For low-coverage or ancient samples use ngsRelate, READv2, KIN or BREADR instead. Handling of first-degree relatives is analysis-specific; see docs/WORKFLOW.md.

name: VIVC
ver_src: vivc.de, checked as the public cultivar name registry
use_en: Public cultivar name registry, used with KING to attach living names to genotypes (AM04).
use_zh: 公开的品种名称登记库，与 KING 一起把基因型对应到现用名称（AM04）。
note: Not software. Do not upload unpublished genotype matrices to this repository.

name: ngsRelate
use_en: Relatedness from genotype likelihoods, including low-coverage data.
use_zh: 用基因型似然估计亲缘，适用于低覆盖度数据。

name: GARLIC
use_en: ROH caller that models length classes explicitly.
use_zh: 显式建模长度类别的 ROH 检测器。

name: RZooRoH
use_en: HMM caller that partitions the genome into multiple HBD (autozygous) classes.
use_zh: 用隐马尔可夫模型把基因组划分成多个同源结合（HBD）类别。

name: bcftools roh
ver_src: same bcftools 1.25 as section 1; also AM12
use_en: HMM runs of homozygosity. AM12 uses population allele frequencies after clone removal, not a default AF file.
use_zh: 用隐马尔可夫模型检测纯合片段。AM12 使用去克隆后按群体估计的等位基因频率，而不是默认频率文件。
note: Default ROH tool in AM12. ROH method paper: Narasimhan et al. 2016, 10.1093/bioinformatics/btw044. The samtools/bcftools suite DOI 10.1093/gigascience/giab008 still applies to the package.

name: hapROH
use_en: ROH from low-coverage data using a haplotype reference panel. Designed and tested on human data (1240k / 1000 Genomes panels). Not a clonal-history method: clonal propagation does not create ROH.
use_zh: 借助单倍型参考面板，从低覆盖度数据检测 ROH。按人类数据（1240k / 千人基因组面板）开发和测试。不能用来推断无性系历史：克隆繁殖不产生 ROH。
inp: pseudo-haploid or low-coverage genotypes, reference panel
note: Human-specific as distributed. Use on Vitis only after building a Vitis phased haplotype panel and validating on modern grapes downsampled to the target depth; unvalidated results must not be reported. ROH reflects inbreeding at the sexual origin of the sampled genotype, not centuries of clonal propagation. Prefer species-general ROHan, or bcftools roh when depth is sufficient. Newest is 0.70 on GitHub/PyPI; Bioconda lagged at 0.64.

name: BayPass
use_en: Bayesian GEA and differentiation, reused from section 5.
use_zh: 贝叶斯遗传-环境关联和分化，与第 5 节为同一工具。

name: LFMM 2
use_en: Genotype-environment association with latent factors.
use_zh: 带潜在因子的基因型-环境关联。
note: Same tool as section 5. Same 1.1 line as the LFMM 2 row in section 5.

name: dartR
use_en: R toolkit for SNP population genetics and some landscape analyses, originally around DArT data.
use_zh: 面向 SNP 群体遗传和部分景观分析的 R 工具包，最初围绕 DArT 数据。

name: wingen
use_en: Mapped genomic diversity and adaptive variation from georeferenced samples.
use_zh: 由带地理坐标的样本绘制基因组多样性和适应性变异。
note: Public coordinates only.

name: BGLR
use_en: Bayesian genomic prediction.
use_zh: 贝叶斯基因组预测。
note: AM24: one sample per clone or duplicate group; keep clones, and first-degree relatives, in the same cross-validation fold.

name: LDSC
ver_src: Bioconda ldsc 1.0.1; GitHub tag still v1.0.0
use_en: LD-score intercepts for inflation and sample overlap in meta-analysis (AM24).
use_zh: 用 LD score 截距看膨胀和样本重叠（AM24）。
note: AM24: use only above a minimum number of SNPs and samples fixed in advance. Human-style LD scores are not a grape map.

name: METAL
use_en: Fixed-effect GWAS meta-analysis; default in AM24.
use_zh: 固定效应 GWAS 荟萃分析，AM24 默认工具。

name: metafor
use_en: Random-effects meta-analysis (REML, Hartung–Knapp) when studies are few.
use_zh: 研究数目较少时用的随机效应荟萃分析（REML，Hartung–Knapp）。
note: AM24 uses this when fewer than five studies.

name: rrBLUP
use_en: Ridge-regression / GBLUP genomic prediction, AM24 alternative.
use_zh: 岭回归 / GBLUP 基因组预测，AM24 备选。

name: GEMMA
use_en: Linear mixed-model GWAS; default per-study tool in AM24.
use_zh: 线性混合模型 GWAS，AM24 中每个研究的默认工具。
note: Keep clones in the same cross-validation fold (AM24).

name: SAIGE
use_en: Saddle-point mixed-model GWAS, mainly for binary traits.
use_zh: 鞍点近似混合模型 GWAS，主要用于二元性状。
note: More common in human data; usable if a grape trait is binary and sample size is large.

name: regenie
use_en: Fast whole-genome regression GWAS, AM24 alternative to GEMMA.
use_zh: 快速全基因组回归 GWAS，AM24 中 GEMMA 的备选。
note: Bioconda has a patch letter (4.1.3.1) on top of GitHub v4.1.3.

name: GAPIT
use_en: R platform wrapping FarmCPU, BLINK, MLMM and related crop GWAS methods.
use_zh: 封装 FarmCPU、BLINK、MLMM 等作物 GWAS 方法的 R 平台。
note: Repository name still says GAPIT3; newest tag is GAPIT4. Record the exact tag you run.

name: TASSEL
ver_src: Official site; version not checked in this build
use_en: Long-standing crop GUI and command-line GWAS and diversity tool.
use_zh: 沿用已久的作物图形界面和命令行 GWAS 与多样性工具。
note: Version [待确认].

name: rMVP
use_en: Memory-efficient crop GWAS and Manhattan plots.
use_zh: 省内存的作物 GWAS 和曼哈顿图。

name: Grapes (DFE)
ver_src: GitHub BioPP/grapes release v1.1.1, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Gamma and related DFE models from SNP counts. Not the grape crop.
use_zh: 用 SNP 计数拟合 gamma 等 DFE 模型。软件名不是作物葡萄。
note: Official repository is BioPP/grapes (Galtier 2016). The previous GitHub URL bioinfo-lessmieux/grapes returned 404. Whether conda-forge package grapes 0.10.4 is the same software remains [待确认]; it is not used as the catalogue version.

name: polyDFE
use_en: Estimates the distribution of fitness effects from SFS, folded or unfolded.
use_zh: 从折叠或未折叠的 SFS 估计适应度效应分布。
note: Polarise as in AM26 before unfolded analyses.

name: Ensembl VEP
use_en: Alternative effect predictor; Ensembl Plants caches must match the chosen grape assembly.
use_zh: 备选效应预测器；Ensembl Plants 缓存必须与所选葡萄组装一致。
note: Confirm that a Vitis cache exists for the assembly you use [待确认] (cache).

name: PlantCaduceus
ver_src: plantcad/plantcad-dev exists (updated 2026-04-23); no stable tag in this check (also AM12)
use_en: Optional plant variant-effect scores, listed as experimental in AM12.
use_zh: 可选的植物变异效应打分，AM12 中列为试验性方法。
note: Version [待确认]. Do not treat unpublished model weights as a repo file.

name: SnpEff
ver_src: Bioconda snpeff 5.4.0c; GitHub tag v5.4c (also AM12)
use_en: Annotates variants against a local database built from the chosen grape annotation (AM12: DS01).
use_zh: 用所选葡萄注释构建的本地数据库给变异做注释（AM12：DS01）。
note: Count load on derived alleles after polarisation (AM26), not on non-reference alleles, because the reference allele is not the ancestral allele.

cluster: SV merging across samples (in order, after calling)
name: Jasmine
use_en: Merges structural-variant callsets across samples after per-sample calling.
use_zh: 在各样本检测完成之后，合并多样本结构变异结果。
note: This is a downstream merge step, not an alternative caller. Use it after Sniffles2 or cuteSV, not as a substitute for them. Short-read SV callers are not listed here; see vitis-pangenome.

name: Sniffles2
use_en: Default long-read structural-variant caller in this section.
use_zh: 本节的默认长读结构变异检测器。
note: Long-read caller, not a short-read tool. Details and short-read SV methods live in vitis-pangenome.

name: cuteSV
use_en: Alternative long-read structural-variant caller.
use_zh: 备选的长读结构变异检测器。
note: Long-read caller, not a short-read tool. Details and short-read SV methods live in vitis-pangenome.

use_zh: 对已经在泛基因组图中的变异做 k-mer 分型。

cluster: Graph genotyping (alternatives; details live in vitis-pangenome)

use_zh: 把读段比对到泛基因组图上，并对图中的变异分型。

name: odgi
use_en: Graph statistics and path similarity; a starting point for graph-aware popgen.
use_zh: 图统计和路径相似性，是面向图的群体遗传的起点。

name: discoal

use_zh: 带选择的溯祖模拟，用来训练选择扫描分类器。

name: scrm
use_en: Sequential coalescent with recombination, a fast ms-like simulator.
use_zh: 带重组的序贯溯祖，较快的 ms 类模拟器。

name: msprime
use_en: Coalescent simulation and recapitation of tree sequences.
use_zh: 树序列的溯祖模拟和 recapitation。
note: Baumdicker et al. 2022 DOI verified (msprime 1.0).

name: stdpopsim
use_en: Standardised simulation catalogue. AM14 records that no official grape model should be assumed.
use_zh: 标准化模拟目录。AM14 写明：不要假定其中已有官方葡萄模型。
note: No Vitis model was confirmed in the catalogue [待确认] (same caveat as AM14).

name: AlphaSimR
use_en: Breeding-program simulation, useful for clonal selection and genomic prediction scenarios.
use_zh: 育种计划模拟，适用于无性选择和基因组预测情景。

name: fwdpy11
ver_src: PyPI fwdpy11 0.24.7 and GitHub molpopgen/fwdpy11 tag v0.24.7 (stable), 2026-11-14 CST; v0.24.8 releases are alpha/pre-release and are not used
use_en: Python forward simulator built on fwdpp; can export tskit tree sequences.
use_zh: 基于 fwdpp 的 Python 前向模拟器，可导出 tskit 树序列。
note: There is no fwdpy2 repository under molpopgen; the current tool is fwdpy11. It is not described as built on tskit; tskit is an export format. DOI [待确认].

name: SLiM
use_en: Forward simulation, including clonal generations relevant to grape.
use_zh: 前向模拟，也可模拟与葡萄相关的无性世代。
note: Verified DOI is Haller and Messer 2023 (SLiM 4). A paper specifically for SLiM 5 was not independently confirmed [待确认]. AM14 lists 5.2.

ver_src: PyPI and conda-forge 1.1.1; GitHub has 1.2.0b1 (beta, not used)
use_en: Links SLiM tree-sequence output to msprime recapitation and tskit.
use_zh: 把 SLiM 的树序列输出接到 msprime recapitation 和 tskit。
note: Latest stable is 1.1.1. GitHub 1.2.0b1 is beta and is not used as the catalog version. Bioconda pyslim 0.401 is stale.

name: CMplot
use_en: Circular and rectangular Manhattan and QQ plots for GWAS.
use_zh: GWAS 的环形或矩形曼哈顿图和 QQ 图。

name: ggtree
use_en: Tree and annotation plots.
use_zh: 树和注释图。

name: pophelper

use_zh: 标准的 ADMIXTURE/STRUCTURE 柱状图。
note: Same tool as section 2.

use_en: Draws demes demographic models.
use_zh: 绘制 demes 人口学模型。

ver_src: Local catalog in vitis-open-directions, not a GitHub release of this repo

use_zh: 项目级模块，覆盖检测、身份、多样性、ROH、祖源、定相、GWAS 和古DNA。
inp: public data listed in that repository
note: The public repository may not be online yet. Content used here is the v3_2 bundle already reviewed on 2026-11-14. grapeancestry remains the 167K product and is not replaced by this catalogue.

use_zh: 社区 Nextflow 流程，用于种系短读变异检测。不是葡萄专用。
note: Version [待确认]. The AM03 sketch (bwa-mem2 + DeepVariant or GATK) is the project default if you do not use sarek.

name: grapeancestry
use_en: 167K FASTQ-to-ancestry product. This catalogue does not replace it.
use_zh: 167K 从 FASTQ 到祖源的产品。本目录不替代它。
note: Out of scope for unpublished genotypes.

name: Dong et al. 2023 resequencing panel (DS11)
use_en: Large published resequencing panel used for structure, domestication and load analyses.
use_zh: 已发表的大型重测序面板，用于结构、驯化和负荷分析。
inp: public reads or VCF as published
note: DOI 10.1126/science.add8655 verified by Crossref. Accessions include NGDC PRJCA009314 (as recorded in the literature review). Cite the original paper when used; the DS11 module in vitis-open-directions has further pointers.

use_zh: 其他已发表的重测序面板，用于群体结构和多样性。

cluster: Ideas still lightly tested on Vitis (complementary)
name: ARG dating of grape domestication
use_en: Use tsinfer/tsdate or Relate on a clone-pruned, polarised panel; compare with aDNA tip dates.
use_zh: 在去克隆、已极化的面板上用 tsinfer/tsdate 或 Relate，并与古DNA末端日期比较。
note: See vitis-open-directions project 10. No results are claimed here. Use sexual-origin times as sample dates for clonal cultivars, and state the generation-time assumption when converting to years.

cluster: Ideas still lightly tested on Vitis (complementary)

use_en: Documented intent: detect clones and duplicates first (one sample per clone group), then treat first-degree relatives in an analysis-specific way rather than dropping them as the same genotype.
use_zh: 拟定做法：先检出克隆和重复（每个克隆组留一个样本），再按分析处理一级亲缘，而不是把他们当成同一基因型删掉。
note: See docs/WORKFLOW.md for the two-step clone versus first-degree rule.

cluster: Ideas still lightly tested on Vitis (complementary)
name: Graph-aware introgression and inversion scans

use_zh: 把渗入和倒位分析从线性 VCF 转到泛基因组图上。
note: Details belong in vitis-pangenome; this repo only points to them.

name: SNPRelate
ver_src: Bioconductor release package SNPRelate 1.46.0, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: IBS, IBD (MoM/MLE) and PCA in R; a cross-check for KING.
use_zh: 在 R 中计算 IBS、IBD（矩估计/极大似然）和 PCA，可作为 KING 的交叉核对。
note: Version is the Bioconductor release page value on 2026-11-14 CST.

name: Technical-replicate IBS or discordance cutoff (idea)
use_en: Calibrate an 'same genotype' IBS or genotype-discordance cutoff from technical replicates and known clone pairs, so sequencing error and somatic differences are not treated as different cultivars.
use_zh: 用同一 DNA 的重复测序和已知克隆对，校准“同一基因型”可接受的 IBS 或基因型不一致率，避免把测序误差和体细胞变异当成不同品种。
out: pairwise discordance distribution and a cutoff
note: Complements the KING 0.354 rule; it does not replace it.

name: GATK Mutect2
ver_src: same GATK 4.7.0.0 already listed for HaplotypeCaller in this catalogue
use_en: Paired somatic-variant calling between clones of the same cultivar.
use_zh: 把同一品种的不同克隆按配对样本比较，寻找体细胞变异。
note: The tool exists. Power and false-positive rate under grape L1/L2 chimerism remain [待确认] and need independent validation. DOI of a Mutect2 methods paper [待确认].

name: L1/L2 chimerism validation design (idea)
use_en: Low-frequency somatic variants should be validated with high depth, biological replicates, and preferably layer-specific tissue. Allele ratios from mixed L1/L2 tissue are not proof of a heritable variant.
use_zh: 等位比例低的体细胞变异需要高深度、生物学重复，最好分层取材，并用独立方法验证。L1/L2 混合组织里的等位比例，不能当成可遗传变异的证据。
note: Biological interpretation of grape chimerism is outside the methods review; this is a design reminder.

name: sequoia

use_zh: 用 SNP 推断亲本、半同胞和多代系谱。先合并克隆再运行。
inp: SNP genotype matrix, optional birth years
note: Many grape cultivars have no reliable 'birth year'; how to set year priors remains [待确认]. Applicability to grape more generally remains [待确认].

name: COLONY
ver_src: software site via the 2010 methods paper; current version not confirmed 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Full-likelihood parentage and sibship inference; supports hermaphrodites and genotyping error.
use_zh: 用全系谱似然推断亲本和同胞关系，支持雌雄同株和基因分型错误。
note: Scalability to thousands of SNPs, and applicability to grape, remain [待确认]. Version [待确认].

name: Mendelian-error check on published trios (idea)
ver_src: uses PLINK already in this catalogue
use_en: Run a Mendelian-error check (for example PLINK --mendel) on literature parent-offspring trios. A high error rate suggests a wrong pedigree or a homonym.
use_zh: 对文献中的亲本-子代三元组做孟德尔错误检验（例如 PLINK --mendel）。错误率高，说明系谱有误，或存在同名异物。
note: Uses the already-listed PLINK 1.9; not a second tool version.

name: VIVC name and genotype cross-check (idea)
ver_src: uses the VIVC resource already listed in section 8
use_en: Cross-check cultivar names, synonyms and genotype identity against VIVC. Homonyms (same name, different genotypes) and synonyms (different names, same genotype) must both be considered; do not merge samples by name alone.
use_zh: 同时根据基因型身份和 VIVC 的名称、同义名记录做交叉核对。同名异物和异名同物都要考虑，不能只按名称合并样本。
note: The VIVC database itself is already catalogued in section 8; this row is the analysis idea.

cluster: Parameters shared by demographic and ARG methods (complementary)
name: Generation time and mutation rate as explicit assumptions (idea)
use_en: SMC, ARG and SFS models convert results to years only after stating generation time and mutation rate. In a clonal crop, a generation is the interval between sexual generations. Germline and somatic rates are different quantities (see vitis-open-directions item 13).
use_zh: SMC、ARG 和 SFS 模型只有在写明世代时间和突变率之后，才能把结果换算成年份。克隆作物的世代是两次有性世代之间的间隔。种系速率和体细胞速率不是同一个量（见 vitis-open-directions 13 号）。
note: Numerical values are not recommended here; they need a genetics and statistics review, and a sensitivity analysis [待确认].

cluster: Parameters shared by demographic and ARG methods (complementary)
name: Sexual-origin time as the sample date (idea)
use_en: Clonal cultivars do not accumulate meiotic generations after their origin. For tsdate, Relate, SINGER and MSMC2, the sample time should be the cultivar's sexual origin, not the year of DNA extraction. Keep one record per clone. The origin date is usually unknown and should be a parameter or a sensitivity analysis, not a known constant. Somatic mutations during clonal propagation can appear as a few overly long ARG tip branches.
use_zh: 克隆繁殖的品种在起源之后不再增加减数分裂代数。对 tsdate、Relate、SINGER 和 MSMC2，样本时间应取品种的有性起源时间，而不是抽 DNA 的年份。同一克隆只保留一份。起源年代通常未知，应作为参数或做敏感性分析，不能当成已知常数。克隆期间的体细胞突变可能在 ARG 末端表现为极少数过长的分支。
note: Do not invent a default origin date or mutation rate here. Numerical values remain [待确认].

name: Chloroplast haplotype as a maternal lineage (idea)
use_en: Plastid haplotypes record the maternal line and are a separate line of evidence from the nuclear genome. Assembly practice lives in grapevine-plastid. Within Vitis, plastid resolution is low and chloroplast capture can occur.
use_zh: 质体单倍型记录母系，是与核基因组独立的一条证据。组装方法见 grapevine-plastid。葡萄属内质体分辨率低，还可能发生叶绿体捕获。
note: Representative Vitis plastid-haplotype papers were not re-checked in this revision [待确认].

cluster: Ideas still lightly tested on Vitis (complementary)
name: Sex-determining region genotype as sample annotation (idea)
use_en: Annotate samples for the grape sex-determining region genotypes (M, F, H). This can infer sex in wild samples. Grape has no heteromorphic sex chromosomes; the locus is a small region on chromosome 2, and most cultivars are hermaphroditic. See vitis-open-directions item 22.
use_zh: 给样本注释葡萄性别决定区基因型（M、F、H），可用来推断野生样本的性别。葡萄没有异形性染色体，该位点是 2 号染色体上的一小段，栽培品种大多是两性花。见 vitis-open-directions 22 号。
inp: aligned reads or VCF around the SDR
note: Pointer only; this repository does not invent a new caller.

name: READv2
use_en: Relatedness from pairwise mismatch rates on pseudo-haploid low-coverage data (up to third degree). Developed on human data; calibrate on modern grape clone and relative pairs downsampled to the same depth. Noraz et al. 2026 (doi:10.1038/s41467-026-70166-z) recalibrated it for grape clones against VIVC, as confirmed against that paper in the 2026-11-14 literature re-review.
use_zh: 用伪单倍型低覆盖数据的两两错配率估计亲缘（可到三级）。按人类数据开发，用于葡萄时要用降到相同深度的现代克隆对和亲缘对校准。Noraz 等 2026（doi:10.1038/s41467-026-70166-z）曾用 VIVC 为葡萄克隆做过校准，已在 2026-11-14 的文献复审中对照该文确认。
note: This is the current READ lineage; the original READ paper (10.1371/journal.pone.0195491) is not a second tool entry.

name: KIN (KINgaroo)
ver_src: GitHub DivyaratanPopli/Kinship_Inference release v3.1.4, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: HMM of IBD segments from low coverage (down to about 0.05x in the human tests), with optional contamination correction and an ROH model. Grape use needs calibration.
use_zh: 用隐马尔可夫模型从低覆盖数据识别 IBD 片段（人类测试中可到约 0.05 倍），可选污染校正和 ROH 模型。用于葡萄需要校准。

name: BREADR
use_en: Posterior probabilities of identical/twins, first-degree, second-degree or unrelated on ultra-low-coverage pseudo-haploid data. The identical class can be used for clone matching between ancient pips and living cultivars after calibration.
use_zh: 针对极低覆盖伪单倍型数据，给出 identical/twins、一级、二级或无关的后验概率。校准后，identical 类可用于古籽与现存品种的克隆匹配。

name: ROHan
ver_src: GitHub grenaud/ROHan release v1.0.7, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Joint estimate of heterozygosity and ROH from a single BAM, with optional damage correction, and without a human haplotype panel. A species-general alternative to hapROH. The paper reports usable depth as low as 5−6x on modern samples and 7−8x on ancient samples with moderate DNA damage.
use_zh: 从单个 BAM 联合估计杂合度和 ROH，可做损伤校正，不依赖人类单倍型面板。可作为 hapROH 的物种通用替代。原文摘要给出的可用覆盖度为：现代样本低至 5−6 倍，有中等损伤的古代样本低至 7−8 倍。
note: ROH still reflects inbreeding at sexual origin, not clonal history.
